verdict.rationale: Deep crawling is a fair question for a web-content extraction tool, but the evidence only shows single-URL conversion (r.jina.ai) and a search endpoint that fetches the top 5 results. Nothing documents link-following crawls, a breadth-first traversal strategy, or a configurable maximum page limit. The search behavior and the x-max-tokens trimming header are adjacent features, not crawl controls.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit
